message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Zhao, a fresh produce sales employee, used his position to issue false delivery orders (without financial audit) and used company seal to issue three delivery orders, then had goods taken out and sold low price to a market, got 30,480 yuan, used part to repay personal debt, rest wasted. The goods value 34,530 yuan. After case, money returned.

This is misappropriation of company funds/goods. The charge likely "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds) or "职务侵占" (occupying by position). In examples, similar case: first example: Lin used position to embezzle company funds for personal purchase of lottery tickets, returned all money, charge given: "挪用资金". That matches: using position to divert company funds for personal use. Another example: Chen case: misused travel agency funds, charge "挪用资金". So answer: 挪用资金.

Check list: "挪用资金" is present. So final answer: [罪名]挪用资金<eoa>

Thus JSON: {"reasoning":"...","final_answer":"挪用资金"}
